name: clef-guard
description: Replaces the built-in auto-mode safety classifier with a local clef decision model

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: URL of the Ollama /v1/systemone endpoint (mTLS ingress or loopback)

model.title: Model
model.description: Decision model served at the endpoint

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: curl shells out (supports mTLS and a hard timeout); http uses the engine's fetch

caCert.title: CA cert
caCert.description: Path to the CA cert for the mTLS ingress (curl transport only; empty = none)

clientCert.title: Client cert
clientCert.description: Path to the client cert the ingress expects (curl transport only; empty = none)

clientKey.title: Client key
clientKey.description: Path to the client key the ingress expects (curl transport only; empty = none)

enforce.title: Enforce
enforce.description: When false, clef only annotates (status line) and never decides

allowThreshold.title: Allow threshold
allowThreshold.description: Minimum P(allow) for clef to allow a call

denyThreshold.title: Deny threshold
denyThreshold.description: Minimum P(deny) for clef to deny a call

harmThreshold.title: Harm threshold
harmThreshold.description: P(harm) at or above which a call is denied (and an allow is vetoed)

timeoutMs.title: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for clef before falling back to the built-in decider

maxStateChars.title: State cap (chars)
maxStateChars.description: Cap on the serialized state sent to clef
